spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): the POST /v1/terminal/refunds request schema in v2274 accepts amount, charge, expand, metadata, payment_intent, reason, refund_application_fee and reverse_transfer; in v2275 only expand remains. The endpoint is documented as an internal endpoint for terminal use. The standard POST /v1/refunds endpoint retains all seven removed properties under identical names in both versions, and POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/refund_payment also keeps its parameter set. Seven records are per-property projections of one request-surface removal.

alternative_data_source: POST /v1/refunds carries the same property names; POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/refund_payment covers reader-driven refunds.

fix.migration_guide: Direct calls to POST /v1/terminal/refunds can no longer pass charge (only expand is accepted). Move the refund creation to the standard POST /v1/refunds endpoint (stripe.refunds.create), which accepts the same property names, or to POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/refund_payment when the refund should be driven through a reader. Property names are unchanged, so the payload can be carried over as-is.
